fusions.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
fusions.desc: Shoulders outward, which deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4.

fusions.name: Lead Bull's Blow
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 30 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding the damage they had left. When it lands, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Herd's Edge
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thick Winter Coat
fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health recovers 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your armour rises by 6%.
